I just wanted to share a bit more information about how the AMP feature works in our app. AMP works by creating a separate, faster version of your page specifically for visitors who come from Google on mobile devices. Your original website remains completely unchanged.

So in simple terms:
• Your Shopify theme > stays exactly the same
• AMP version > only used as a fast-loading mobile page for visitors coming from Google

This means the AMP feature does not replace your template and does not modify your live store design.

It simply creates a lighter and faster copy of your page to help improve mobile loading speed and performance on Google search.

Please feel free to let me know if you have any questions. I'm always happy to help! 😊

Best regards,
Ivy
